descricao_original: An arteriole consists of a tunica intima, a thin tunica media of one to two layers of smooth muscle cells and a tunica adventitia. The wall of the adjacent venule is thinner and less regular, consisting only of an endothelium, forming the tunica intima. A tunica media is absent and the thin tunica adventitia is indistinguishable from the surrounding connective tissue. 1000x
